entities.name: 2006 New York City plane crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On October 11, 2006, a Cirrus SR20 aircraft crashed into the Belaire Apartments on the Upper East Side of Manhattan, New York City, United States, at about 2:42 p.m. EDT. The aircraft struck the north side of the building, causing a fire in several apartments that was extinguished within two hours.
